name: Lesson 24 · The red dress: adjective endings after der, die, das

cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). After der, die or das the article already shows the case, so the adjective takes just -e in the nominative.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). der Mantel: der + -e.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). die Jacke: die + -e.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). die + -e in the nominative.

cards.front: **The white** shirt belongs to my brother.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). das Hemd: das + -e.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). dunkel drops its second e when an ending follows: dunkle.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). der Rock: der + -e.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). der + -e.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). die Farbe is the subject of gefällt: die + -e.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). In the plural, after die, the ending is always -en.

cards.front: **The yellow** flowers are for you. (one friend)
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). Plural: die + -en.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). The masculine accusative is the one singular -en: den grünen.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). tragen: to wear; sie trägt. der Rock → den gelben Rock.

cards.front: Do you see **the tall** man? (one friend)
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). den + -en.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). den grünen Schlüssel: the object of verloren.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). Feminine and neuter accusative look like the nominative: die rote.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). die Hose → die schwarze Hose.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). die + -e.

cards.front: Do you know **the young** teacher? (a woman; one friend)
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). die junge: accusative feminine, the same as the nominative.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). das + -e, as in the nominative. tragen: er trägt.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). das alte: accusative neuter.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). Plural accusative: die + -en.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). In the dative every ending is -en: dem jungen.

cards.front: The cat is sleeping under **the big** table.
cards.back: Die Katze schläft unter **dem großen** Tisch.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). unter + dative for where: dem großen.

cards.front: The cat is sitting on **the blue** chair.
cards.back: Die Katze sitzt auf **dem blauen** Stuhl.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). auf + dative: dem blauen Stuhl.

cards.front: The child is playing with **the big** dog.
cards.back: Das Kind spielt mit **dem großen** Hund.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). mit + dative: dem großen.

cards.front: The trousers don't fit **the tall** man.
cards.back: Die Hose passt **dem großen** Mann nicht.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). passen + dative: dem großen Mann.

cards.front: The jacket is hanging next to **the brown** cupboard.
cards.back: Die Jacke hängt neben **dem braunen** Schrank.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). neben + dative: dem braunen.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). das Auto → dem roten Auto.

cards.front: The book belongs to **the old** woman.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). die Frau → der alten Frau in the dative.

cards.back: In **der neuen** Wohnung ist es warm.
cards.note: Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). in + dative: der neuen Wohnung.
Adjective endings after der, die, das (weak). Dative plural: den + -en, and Kindern with -n.
